title: TikTok rolls out an AI shopping assistant and one-click checkout | TechCrunch
summary: TikTok announced Monday that it’s launching an AI shopping assistant and a new in-app checkout feature that lets users buy directly from brands. TikTok describes its new Shopping Assistant as a conversational AI agent designed to help users discover and purchase products.
